_note: Hand-curated interaction rules that DDInter lacks: its bulk files do not hold several cardiovascular pairs, and Indian-only drugs are missing. Each rule expands to every a x b pair. Where DDInter also lists a pair, the more severe level is used. Severity and wording are drafts for the pharmacist to confirm.

rules.note: dual blockade of the renin-angiotensin system raises the risk of low blood pressure, high potassium and kidney injury
rules.source: ONTARGET (N Engl J Med 2008;358:1547); product labelling. Added by the developer, not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: both raise potassium; high potassium is more likely in older adults and in kidney impairment
rules.source: Product labelling (US FDA / EMA SmPC). Added by the developer, not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: contraindicated: raises domperidone levels; risk of QT prolongation, serious ventricular arrhythmia and sudden cardiac death
rules.source: EMA domperidone referral 2014 and Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (contraindicated with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors); members from the US FDA list of strong CYP3A inhibitors. DDInter has no domperidone entry. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: contraindicated: both prolong the QT interval; risk of serious ventricular arrhythmia
rules.source: EMA domperidone referral 2014 and Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (contraindicated with QT-prolonging drugs); members are examples named in the domperidone SmPC, not a complete list. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: both prolong the QT interval: risk of torsade de pointes
rules.source: ONC high-priority DDI list (Phansalkar et al., JAMIA 2012;19:735, rule: QT-prolonging agents); product labelling. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: contraindicated in the EU (avoid per the US label): raises ivabradine levels and adds to heart-rate lowering
rules.source: Ivabradine SmPC section 4.3 (medicines.org.uk/emc/product/9609); US prescribing information. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: additive slowing of heart rate and AV conduction: bradycardia, heart block, low blood pressure, heart failure
rules.source: Verapamil SmPC section 4.5 (medicines.org.uk/emc/product/979); product labelling. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist

rules.note: raises digoxin levels and slows AV conduction: digoxin toxicity, heart block
rules.source: Verapamil SmPC section 4.5 (measure the digoxin level, reduce the dose if needed); product labelling. Added by the developer (24 Oct 2026), not yet checked by a pharmacist
